established_idea: Conditional delivery distributions require a service rule, cost or reliability constraint before becoming a customer promise.
olist_boundary: Live inventory, queue, carrier and network state and Olist's original promise objective are undocumented.
thesis_response: Evaluate historical process profiles as a post-promise risk-assessment layer around the recorded estimate.

established_idea: Late probability and delay length are related but non-equivalent outcomes.
olist_boundary: Final breach and severity are observable only after customer delivery.
thesis_response: Model missed-date probability and breached-order positive-lateness Q50/Q90 separately.

established_idea: Longer and promise-relative delivery failures are associated with ratings and later behaviour in the cited settings.
olist_boundary: Olist reviews are selected, timing-limited and not pure logistics-satisfaction labels.
thesis_response: Use observed low reviews as observational customer-relevance evidence, with timing sensitivity.

established_idea: Sparse entity rates require support, uncertainty and shrinkage-aware interpretation.
olist_boundary: Seller and state-OD histories have uneven support; case mix remains unresolved.
thesis_response: Construct point-in-time raw/shrinkage candidates and retain support, cold start, uncertainty and freshness.

established_idea: Later-origin evaluation, proper scores, reliability and quantile coverage answer different questions.
olist_boundary: Profile definitions and terminal regimes are not external or prospective holdouts.
thesis_response: Use development selection, subsequent process confirmation, six later cohorts and separate terminal stress.
